method: UI in Claude in Chrome session, the test account, pt-BR, Free plan. Read only. No conversation was opened, answered, assigned or closed.
observations: The inbox lives on its own host, conversations-app.brevo.com, reached from Conversas > Caixa de entrada.

Views in the left list: Minhas mensagens (/conversations/myopen, empty: 'Vocês estão todos atualizados!'), Não atribuídas (/conversations/unassigned, 1 conversation: a system 'Welcome Bot' message), Todas as mensagens. 'Visitantes online' and 'Estatísticas' carry the crown (paid).
Top of the list: an availability selector ('Online' with a warning icon), a status filter ('Abertas'), a sort button and a search icon.
Settings of the inbox were read separately (see inventory/ui_crawl_pass4_settings_detail.md).
limitations: No conversation was opened, so the reply box, assignment, snooze and close controls were not seen.
'Todas as mensagens' was not opened in this pass.
